Meeza says the company is on track to “quadruple” its current data centre capacity

Staff Writer ,  ZAWYA

Meeza, the Qatar-listed data centre and managed IT services provider, has inked a 1 billion riyals ($275 million) agreement with a global hyperscaler to provide 8 megawatts of operational capacity under a long-term leasing agreement.
